instance hp2 : I2.IsPrime := (Ideal.span_singleton_prime (by norm_num)).mpr Int.prime_two

  relMatrix := Matrix.of fun _ _ => (2 : ℤ)
  proj := Submodule.mkQ (LinearMap.range kk)
  surjective_proj := Submodule.mkQ_surjective _
  exact_mulVecLin_proj := by
    have h : LinearMap.ker (Submodule.mkQ (LinearMap.range kk))
        = LinearMap.range (Matrix.of fun (_ _ : Fin 1) => (2:ℤ)).mulVecLin := by
      rw [Submodule.ker_mkQ]; rfl
    exact LinearMap.exact_iff.mpr h.symm

  rw [Module.MatrixPresentation.entryIdeal]
  congr 1
  ext z
  exact ⟨by rintro ⟨_, rfl⟩; rfl, by rintro rfl; exact ⟨(0,0), rfl⟩⟩

  (Pc.entryIdeal_le_prime_iff I2).mp (le_of_eq hentry)

Steps 4-6 alone already reach fiberH0.  So hbc identifies the fibre of Gamma(p_* M, top);
